title: Screw Puzzle
description: Unscrew colored bolts from overlapping acrylic boards into matching boxes while keeping the buffer holes from overflowing.
controls: Tap exposed screws to remove them into matching colored boxes. Clear every board to advance.

zh-CN.title: 打螺丝
zh-CN.description: 拧下叠层亚克力板上的彩色螺丝装入同色盒子，善用空槽与道具拆光全部木板通关。
zh-CN.controls: 点击未被遮挡的螺丝将其拧下，凑齐同色三颗装满盒子；注意别让备用孔位塞满。
